messages:
maria_infra: Heads-up — planning a staggered maintenance window for APAC edge pool tonight 00:30-03:00 local (UTC+8). Scope: NIC microcode + BMC firmware on 3 racks (racks a3,a4,a5). Expect rolling cordon -> graceful drain -> reboot. Will do KV cache priming after each rack.
arun_sre: ETA and impact? will capacity drop for hosted pools?
maria_infra: Expected capacity hit ~12% for ~15m per rack during drain/backfill. We have burst capacity in eu/us to absorb short tails. No dedicated customer evictions planned; we'll prefer backfill to standby nodes.
casey_ops: Can we shift some low-priority preemptible jobs to us-east for the window? I can trigger backfill scripts.
maria_infra: Yes — plan is to shift interruptible workloads first. Casey, please run the backfill 15m before cordon for each rack. Use: ```./ops backfill --region us-east1 --label preemptible --until 00:50``` and confirm.
casey_ops: ack. I'll run dry-run now and post results.
jenna_prod: Heads-up for Support: if customer-facing latency goes up, support should route to the status page and link our incident doc. I'm prepping a short blurb for the status page now.
luis_neteng: I'll be on NIC firmware steps and will test a single host before rack-wide. If we see >2% packet drops in perf probe, we abort and rollback.
oncall-bot: @maria_infra scheduled maintenance window created: INC-APAC-1729. Reminder 30m before start.
maria_infra: Thanks. Canary plan: pick 2 hosts in rack a3, reboot one at a time, run synthetic reqs to the inference endpoint for top 5 models, check p50/p95 and error rate. If p95 latency delta > 80ms or errors >0.5%, abort.
arun_sre: For routing: enable cross-region fallback policy 'apac-nic-fallback' during window so new requests can hit eu-hosted pool. I'll flip the config at start and revert after.
casey_ops: backfill dry-run: 42 jobs moved, estimated 8 extra gpus used in us-east for 00:30-01:10 window. cost delta ~ $120 for the window (rough). posting logs: ```Backfill: moved 42 jobs; freed 6 gpus in apac.``` 
maria_infra: Good. After each rack reboot we need to run kvseed to prewarm K/V cache for model serving: ```./ops kvseed --pool apac-edge --parallel 8 --models small,base,large``` aim to cut cold-start tails.
luis_neteng: NIC flash note: must set link training to legacy mode on first host: ```ip link set dev eth0 down; ethtool -s eth0 autoneg off;``` then flash.
jenna_prod: Draft status page message ready and includes INC-APAC-1729 + expected impact and timeline. I'll post 20m before start.
support-bot: Notifying support rota. Pager for tonight: @oncall-signal will be pinged if incidents escalate.
arun_sre: Quick question on Dedicated pools — customers on dedicated racks a3-a5? I think none are reserved on those racks, but confirm.
maria_infra: Confirmed: no dedicated reservations on those racks. They host hosted inference + preemptibles. We still need to notify account execs just in case. Jenna please run the exec notify template.
jenna_prod: Doing now. Template: "Maintenance INC-APAC-1729 tonight 00:30-03:00 local — rolling reboots. Expected brief capacity impact ~12% for short windows; fallback to EU automatic. Contact support if you see degraded performance." Sharing in #customer-notify.
casey_ops: Starting cordon for rack a3 in 10m (dry-run complete). Command I will run: ```kubectl cordon node-a3-{01..12}; ./ops drain --grace 120 --selectors gpu=true --eviction-mode graceful``` posting output after.
maria_infra: Reminder: keep canary metrics for 10m after node rejoin. If everything green, proceed to a4. If not, pause and roll back config flips.
casey_ops: cordon + drain done for a3 hosts. Backfill freed 7 gpus. Reboot and join in progress.
oncall-bot: Alert: canary-check failed on model 'base-v2' (p95 +120ms). @arun_sre @maria_infra please investigate.
arun_sre: Investigating — looking at kernel logs and NIC stats.
casey_ops: Rolling the node back (power-cycle aborted) and uncordoning remaining nodes in a3 to restore capacity.
maria_infra: Good call. We'll pause window for 30m to investigate root cause. Reverting apac-nic-fallback now.
luis_neteng: Initial signal looks like NIC training regression after flash on that host. I will rollback firmware on that host and re-run training tests.
jenna_prod: Notifying customers of brief extension and that we paused after detecting an issue. Posting update on status.
support-bot: Support rota notified of pause; no customer escalations yet.
casey_ops: rollback firmware completed on canary host; perf probe shows baseline p95. Recommend re-run canary on a single host after 20m soak.
maria_infra: Agreed. Resuming plan: canary on a single host after 20m soak; if green, continue with rest of racks. Thanks all — I'll update this thread with next start time and any follow-ups.
jenna_prod: Posted status update + exec note.
arun_sre: I'll follow-up with a short postmortem if NIC firmware is flaky; we'll add a preflight training check to the playbook.
maria_infra: Closing loop: INC-APAC-1729 remains open; pause logged. New tentative resume 01:25 local (UTC+8). Will confirm 10m prior. :white_check_mark:
